GWA_SamiraHolt.name: Captain Samira Holt
GWA_SamiraHolt.voice: Concise, calm, operational. She asks what is known, what is assumed, and what changes if the crew is wrong.
GWA_SamiraHolt.visualAnchor: Adult Fleet captain with close-kept dark curls, a composed angular face, and a practical deep-navy command uniform with restrained white and gold Fleet detailing. Compact scout-ship duty wear rather than ceremonial dress.
GWA_SamiraHolt.performance: Stillness under pressure. She listens fully before giving an order; when she changes course, it should read as evidence changing the decision rather than indecision.
promptContinuity: Shared Fleet identity is deep navy / blue / white / restrained gold.
Do not give Samira special anomaly intuition. Her competence is command judgment.
Keep rank treatment practical and understated.

GWA_MinaOkafor.name: Mina Okafor
GWA_MinaOkafor.role: Ghostwind Arrow — senior sensor technician / recurring viewpoint
GWA_MinaOkafor.voice: Precise, observant, economical. She distinguishes the reading from the explanation.
GWA_MinaOkafor.visualAnchor: Adult Fleet sensor technician with dark braided hair secured back from the face, alert eyes, compact deep-navy technical-duty layers, and a practical instrument harness used for calibration and probe work.
GWA_MinaOkafor.performance: Attention is physical: comparing two plots, touching a reference marker, checking a second clock, looking past the obvious display. Avoid mystical staring into space.
promptContinuity: Mina notices discrepancies because she checks them, not because she senses anomalies.
Her station and handheld tools should remain visually consistent after first approval.
Violet/purple appears in survey data and sensor overlays, not as her personal costume color.

GWA_OwenIbarra.name: Lieutenant Owen Ibarra
GWA_OwenIbarra.voice: Technically fluent, dry, willing to defend a model and equally willing to discard it when a measurement breaks it.
GWA_OwenIbarra.visualAnchor: Adult Fleet navigator with short dark hair, lean build, and deep-navy duty uniform at a compact navigation station with physical handholds and local reference displays.
GWA_OwenIbarra.performance: Works problems in real time. Frustration should be directed at bad assumptions or incomplete geometry, never at being contradicted by evidence.
promptContinuity: Use reciprocal gap, shear, anchor, timing and local reference geometry as operational quantities without turning dialogue into lecture.
Owen and Mina disagree productively; neither is the permanent skeptic or permanent believer.

GWA_TomasVarga.name: Chief Engineer Tomas Varga
GWA_TomasVarga.voice: Practical, skeptical of explanations that have not eliminated ship-side causes.
GWA_TomasVarga.visualAnchor: Older Fleet engineer with a broad work-worn face, cropped graying hair, deep-navy engineering layers with rolled practical sleeves, tool tabs, and visible use rather than decorative grime.
GWA_TomasVarga.performance: Tests hardware before theories. His humor is dry and occupational; he enjoys proving the ship innocent.
promptContinuity: Engineering spaces should remain cramped and physically connected to the command deck by repeatable access routes.
No magical repairs or instantaneous system swaps.

GWA_NessaReed.name: Flight Officer Nessa Reed
GWA_NessaReed.role: Ghostwind Arrow — scout pilot / EVA and probe operations
GWA_NessaReed.voice: Direct, tactile, and grounded in what a route feels like to fly without treating feeling as proof.
GWA_NessaReed.visualAnchor: Adult Fleet scout pilot with short light-brown hair, compact athletic build, deep-navy flight layers, white restraint harness points, and restrained gold Fleet identifiers.
GWA_NessaReed.performance: Reads space through motion, sightlines, acceleration and control response. She can report pilot feel, but she expects the sensor team to test it.
promptContinuity: No ace-pilot swagger as default behavior.
Flight competence is precise and procedural, especially when the corridor becomes visually misleading.

GWA_NikoPell.name: Convoy Master Niko Pell
GWA_NikoPell.role: Verge relief convoy master — Issue 1 supporting character
GWA_NikoPell.voice: Blunt, tired, respectful of risk but responsible for people who cannot eat caution.
GWA_NikoPell.visualAnchor: Older civilian convoy master in patched tan and muted-green Verge flight layers, practical comm headset, worn route tabs, and no Fleet insignia.
GWA_NikoPell.performance: Pressure comes from logistics, not melodrama. He asks for usable answers because his cargo and destination are time-sensitive.
